prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity dark-appearance product design concept for an existing native macOS desktop app, one complete screen.
Primary request: Create the Dark Aqua counterpart of the supplied light HEAV3NS-CODE workspace concept. Preserve its composition, exact content, window geometry, pane ratios, icon vocabulary, and control placement. Change only the appearance to a polished native macOS dark presentation. The second supplied screenshot is the current native dark app reference for material and control character, not its approval-sheet content.
Input images: image 1 is the light workspace concept and is the structural and content reference. Image 2 is the incumbent compact dark workspace and is a material/appearance reference only. Do not adopt the compact composition of image 2.
Composition: straight-on perfectly flat full-window UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, 1600 by 1000 pixels if supported. Native toolbar 56 points high; 208-point source-list sidebar; conversation and read-only inspector side by side, similar widths; persistent composer across both working panes at the bottom. No wallpaper, device frame, perspective, annotations, or surrounding presentation layout.
Retain exact key text: "LUMI-NEW", "main · HEAV3NS-CODE", "Connected", "Stop", "Files", "Changes", "Sessions", "Filter changes", "WorkspaceWindow.swift", "NavigationSidebar.swift", "Modified", "2 changed files", "Agent", "Task finished", "You", "Make the workspace easier to scan.", "LUMI", "I refined the spacing and clarified the navigation. The composer stays visible while you inspect changes.", "Read workspace views", "Adjusted layout spacing", "Prepared change summary", "Checks not run · Not reviewed", "Open a changed file to inspect the result.", "Working Tree", "Staged", "Working tree vs HEAD", "Includes pre-existing and external edits", "Read only", "Previous", "Next Page", "Explain the changes before we continue.", "Enter to send · Shift–Enter for a new line", "Up Next", "Send".
Inspector diff: retain the short plain-text monospaced unified diff including "@@ Workspace layout @@", "- spacing = 6", "+ spacing = 10", "  alignment = .leading", "  composer.isEditable = true". Keep the plus and minus characters readable. No edit/stage/apply controls.
Appearance: native dark neutral graphite, subtle separation among sidebar, toolbar, transcript and inspector planes. Off-white high-contrast primary text, legible secondary text, understated thin separators, restrained macOS system blue selection and Send emphasis. Realistic active window traffic lights. Rounded controls follow macOS, no custom glass aesthetic, halos, glowing borders, pure-black voids, neon, saturated purple, or decorative gradients.
Typography: crisp San Francisco-like system type and SF Mono-like code, 14-point body, 12–13 point labels, 11-point metadata. Preserve alignment, generous text breathing room, and serious desktop utility density. No giant headings or chat bubbles. Interface must be fully readable with all bottom controls visible.
Constraints: This is a native workspace design proposal with illustrative task content, not proof that a task ran. Keep the exact same product capabilities and only change the light/dark material treatment. No new features, logos, model pickers, dashboards, terminal, web browser chrome, code editor tabs, or marketing language.
